prompt:
A full-fidelity desktop website design comp, 16:9 landscape, showing the top of the page at 1440 px wide, rendered edge to edge as the page itself (no browser window, no device). The website for PrismTTY, a live terminal-output highlighter for network engineers. World: a data-center fiber patch field. Ground: matte black powder-coated rack steel (#0a0a0b to #1c1d20) with subtle real metal texture and engraved white port labels.

Regions, top to bottom:
1. Navigation is a photographic 1U black fiber patch panel spanning the full width at the top: a row of duplex LC ports, six of them labeled by engraved white labels that act as links: "OVERVIEW", "PROFILES", "SWITCHING", "INSTALL", "SCOPE", "GITHUB". Fiber patch cords in the TIA-598 color code (blue #2f6fd6, orange #f28c28, green #3fae49, slate #8e9aa6) are plugged into a few ports. Far left on the panel: an engraved prism-triangle logo mark (outlined triangle with a tiny terminal window inside) and the wordmark "PrismTTY".
2. Left half below the panel, on black steel: a headline in a condensed industrial grotesk, white, large: "Readable output, live in your terminal." Under it a short paragraph: "One wrapped shell colors SSH, console, pipe and log output as it flows, and follows you from device to device. Nine built-in profiles. Nothing stored by default." Then the primary action: an engraved label-plate install bar "$ brew install inxbit/tap/prismtty" with a "COPY" button, and a secondary text link "View on GitHub".
3. Right half, the focal element: a flat dark terminal output panel (#111214) into which two fiber cords run from the patch panel above, showing real highlighted Cisco output: "LAB-IOS-01#show interfaces description", then rows "Gi1/0/1  up  up  Uplink to LAB-CORE", "Gi1/0/2  down  down  Spare access port", "Po10  up  up  Bundle to DIST-A", then "O  192.0.2.0/24 [110/20] via 198.51.100.1, Vlan1191". The prompt is white, interface names bright blue #0099ff, every "up" pure green #00ff00, "down" bold pure red #ff0000, IP addresses cyan #00ffff. A small engraved tag on the panel reads "profile: cisco".
4. At the bottom edge, the start of the next section: the heading "Nine built-in profiles" over a row of nine engraved port labels: "generic", "linux-unix", "cisco", "juniper", "fortinet", "palo-alto", "arista", "arubacx", "versa".

Photographic-quality rack hardware, crisp, dark and precise. No neon glow, no gradients on text. Real readable text at real size, about 16 px body on a 1440 px page.
